in_marathi.name: प्रशांत
in_marathi.long_meaning: प्रशांत हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name प्रशांत is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Prashanth’, meaning calm, peaceful, and tranquil. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is known as the preserver of the universe and the embodiment of peace and tranquility.
